# STAR Launcher — Legacy Reference Audit (`STAR_LEGACY_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md`)

> **Repository Root**: `D:\what\AetherLauncher` (Git `origin`: `https://github.com/AngelAuraMC/Amethyst-Android.git`, branch `v3_openjdk`).  
> *(Note: `d:\Aether Launcher` only holds Gradle/IDE workspace metadata `.gradle/` and `.idea/` pointing builds away from the actual source root; all source, resource, manifest, and documentation files live in `D:\what\AetherLauncher`.)*

## 1. Audit Scope & Methodology

Scanned all tracked/non-build source, resource, manifest, build configuration, script, and documentation files across the repository prior to this cleanup pass for case-insensitive references to:

- `PojavLauncher`, `pojavlauncher`, `Pojav`, `PojavApplication`
- `Aether Launcher`, `Aether Lab`, `AetherDashboardActivity`, `Aether*` symbols
- `app_pojavlauncher`
- `net.kdt.pojavlaunch`, `dev.aetherlauncher`, `org.angelauramc`
- `Amethyst`, `AngelAuraMC`, `Boardwalk`

**Binary Asset Filtering**: A raw path+content scan initially flagged 101 binary files because 99 unrelated `.png`/`.webp`/`.jar`/`.ttf` assets reside inside the `app_pojavlauncher/` folder prefix. Filtering binary assets by filename isolates **2 genuinely legacy-named binary assets** (`app_pojavlauncher/src/main/assets/amethyst.png` and `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/res/drawable/ic_pojav_full.webp`), yielding **3,533 audited legacy references** across **438 files** (3,531 text line matches + 2 legacy-named binary assets).

## 2. Classification Summary

| Classification | Count | Treatment Policy | Risk if Renamed Blindly |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| `USER_FACING_BRANDING` | 21 | Replace outdated branding/user/log copy with STAR Launcher; flag unused `amethyst.png`. | Low |
| `DOCUMENTATION` | 299 | Update user-facing/architecture docs to STAR Launcher while preserving upstream/historical records. | Low |
| `INTERNAL_GRADLE_MODULE` | 46 | Retain `:app_pojavlauncher`, `namespace 'net.kdt.pojavlaunch'`, and permanent `applicationId` `com.star.launcher`. | High–Critical |
| `SOURCE_CLASS_OR_PACKAGE` | 2816 | Retain inherited Java/Kotlin/C classes, packages, JNI symbols (`PojavApplication`, `AetherDashboardActivity`, `AetherDatabase`, etc.). | High–Critical |
| `UPSTREAM_ATTRIBUTION` | 73 | Retain verbatim legal notices, `LICENSE`, `about_en.txt`, credits, and upstream technical attribution. | Critical (Legal) |
| `LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY` | 49 | Retain storage directories, Room DB filename, Keystore alias, `amethyst://` URI, `.aetherpart`, `AMETHYST_*` native keys, and upstream JRE/wiki URLs. | High–Critical |
| `TEST_OR_FIXTURE` | 212 | Retain unit test contracts and Room schema JSON snapshots under `app_pojavlauncher/schemas/`. | High |
| `GENERATED_OR_THIRD_PARTY` | 17 | Leave untouched (`MioLibPatcher`, `androidnsbypass`, SDL headers, vendor `.aar` libs, `bigcoreaffinity.c`). | High |
| `UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW` | 0 | Manual review required. | Unknown |
| **Total Audited** | **3533** | Across **438** files (`0` unknown) | — |

## 3. Deferred Internal Identifier Dependency Chain & Migration Plan

Per project constraints, internal identifiers were **not** renamed during this branding/documentation cleanup. If STAR Launcher later decides to migrate any of these symbols, each item requires the following dependency-chain work and data/runtime migration:

| Internal Identifier | Current Role | Full Dependency Chain | Migration Plan (Future Phase) | Risk |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:app_pojavlauncher` (Gradle module) | Main Android application module | `settings.gradle`, root/subproject `build.gradle` (`arc_dns_injector`, `forge_installer`, `jre_lwjgl3glfw`), `.github/workflows/android.yml`, `scripts/`, `.gitignore`, `crowdin.yml`, Android Studio `.cxx` prefab caches | Coordinated single PR updating `settings.gradle`, all `project(':app_pojavlauncher')` paths, CI YAML, and CMake/prefab build paths after clean cache wipe | High |
| `net.kdt.pojavlaunch.*` (Java namespace & JNI) | Java package, Manifest namespace, and C/C++ JNI bindings | 200+ Java classes, `AndroidManifest.xml`, `app_pojavlauncher/src/main/jni/*.c` (`Java_net_kdt_pojavlaunch_*`, `FindClass("net/kdt/pojavlaunch/...")`), ProGuard rules, custom controls/XML layouts | Update C JNI symbol signatures + `FindClass` strings + Java `package` declarations + XML + `proguard-rules.pro` in lockstep; validate on ARM64/ARM32/x86_64 physical devices | Critical |
| `PojavApplication` | `Application` subclass instantiated in `:launcher`, `:game`, `:gui_installer` | `AndroidManifest.xml` (`android:name=".PojavApplication"`), `PojavLaunchBridge.kt` (`getMainLooper()` check / init) | Rename class and update `AndroidManifest.xml` `<application android:name>` if desired once `net.kdt.pojavlaunch` refactor occurs | High |
| `AetherDashboardActivity` & UI class prefixes (`AetherNavRoutes`, `AetherIcons`, `AetherTheme`) | Internal Compose Hub Activity and UI module types | `AndroidManifest.xml`, `TestStorageActivity.java`, `ExitActivity.java`, Kotlin Compose navigation/UI callers | Pure internal code symbols (never shown in UI). Optional IDE refactor in a dedicated Kotlin cleanup PR; update `AndroidManifest.xml` & Java callers (`Intent(ctx, ...)`) | Medium |
| `AetherDatabase` / `aether_launcher.db` | Room SQLite database & filename | `AetherContainer.kt`, 10 Room entities, DAOs, `app_pojavlauncher/schemas/.../*.json`, `PojavLaunchBridge.kt` WAL checkpoint before exit | Keep filename or copy/rename `aether_launcher.db` (+ `-wal`/`-shm`) once atomically on cold startup before `Room.databaseBuilder()` opens | Critical (data loss if not migrated) |
| `aether_instances/`, `aether_downloads/`, `aether_spool/`, `aether_exports/`, `aether_vault/` | Internal directories & JSON telemetry spool | `AetherStorageManager.kt`, `InstanceManager.kt`, `CrossProcessSpoolBridge.kt`, `MainActivity.java`, `GameService.java` | Retain or add startup folder migration + dual-read fallback for `aether_spool/` before deleting legacy folder names | High |
| `aether_token_vault_v1` (EncryptedSharedPreferences) | Hardware-backed Keystore token storage | `TokenVault.kt`, `AccountRepository.kt`, auth refresh flows | Do **not** change Keystore alias without copying decrypted tokens to a new EncryptedSharedPreferences file before clearing old vault | Critical (breaks saved accounts) |
| `Tools.LAUNCHERPROFILES_RTPREFIX = "amethyst://"`, `.aetherpart`, `AMETHYST_RENDERER`, `socketName = "Amethyst"` | Profile RT prefix, partial download suffix, env vars, TouchController IPC | `Tools.java`, `JMinecraftVersionList`, `LauncherProfiles.java`, `MinecraftDownloader.java`, `VersionManager.kt`, `JREUtils.java`, `egl_bridge.c`, `TouchControllerUtils.java`, `PojavLaunchBridgeTest.kt` | Keep for backward compatibility with existing `launcher_profiles.json` and external mods (`TouchController`) | High |
| `ic_pojav_full` drawable ID | Bundled profile icon resource ID (visual already updated to STAR emblem) | `ProfileIconCache.java` | Keep resource identifier or alias `<bitmap>` when updating Java icon cache | Low–Medium |
| `amethyst.png` (`app_pojavlauncher/src/main/assets/amethyst.png`) | Unused legacy banner image (1.28 MB) | Unreferenced in current Kotlin/Java/XML/Markdown (`README.md` uses `star_logo.png`) | Confirm no external workflow/Crowdin script fetches it, then remove in an APK-size cleanup commit | Low |
